noise_seeding.image_id_normalization: Unicode NFC; then backslash -> forward slash; then UTF-8 encoded; no other change
noise_seeding.digest_to_seed: first 8 bytes of the SHA-256 digest, big-endian unsigned 64-bit integer, passed to numpy.random.default_rng
noise_seeding.salt_pepper: corrupted = U1 < density; salt if U2 < 0.5 else pepper; U1, U2 drawn in that order from the per-image stream (polarity independent of severity)

stream_fingerprint.probe: default_rng(42): random(8) then normal(size=8); float64 little-endian bytes

threshold_protocol: max-accuracy on clean validation balanced pairs; frozen for test
